name: Amazon.com Inc.
note: Anthropic is filed fair-value equivalent converted to pre-split share-equivalents at Series H-1 ($589.0095, S-1 p. F-47) and divided by the S-1 FD denominator (p. 13, which assumes full conversion of the Amazon Notes). OpenAI is round-implied from the $50B Series C.

security.label: Conv + Pfd
security.footnote: Anthropic: $92.5B nonvoting preferred + $97.9B convertible notes (AMZN 10-Q as of 2026-06-30), converted to 323.3M pre-split share-equivalents at Series H-1 ($589.0095, S-1 p. F-47). Notes convert into non-voting Class N at the IPO up to Amazon's ownership cap, remainder quarterly afterwards or cash at maturity (S-1 pp. 20, 165); the S-1 FD count (p. 13) assumes full conversion.

sources.note: Nonvoting preferred $92.5B + convertible notes FV $97.9B = $190.4B. $100B AWS is not equity.

Amazon's convertible notes convert into non-voting Class N at the IPO up to its ownership cap; the remainder converts quarterly afterwards (lowest of fixed price, IPO price, 10-day VWAP) or is repaid in cash at maturity (S-1 pp. 20, 165). The S-1's fully diluted count as of June 30, 2026 assumes full conversion of the Amazon Notes (S-1 p. 13). Measured at Series H-1 ($589.0095 pre-split, S-1 p. F-47).

anthropic.evidenceNote: Amazon's convertible notes convert into Class N at the IPO subject to its ownership cap, with the remainder converting quarterly afterwards (lowest of fixed price, IPO price, 10-day VWAP) or repaid in cash at maturity (S-1 pp. 20, 165). The S-1's 1,778.4M pre-split fully diluted count (S-1 p. 13) assumes full conversion of the Amazon Notes. Converted to share-equivalents at Series H-1 ($589.0095 pre-split, S-1 p. F-47).

sources.note: $15.0B Series C in Q1 + $13.7B in Q2 = $28.7B on the 2026-06-30 balance sheet; subsequent event funded the remaining $21.3B, completing $50B. $100B AWS is not equity.

openai.dateNote: June 30 balance sheet $28.7B plus post-quarter $21.3B by the July 10-Q publication. Exact completion day not disclosed.
